spans.s: जित् a. (at the end of compounds only) Vanquishing, conquering, winning &c., e.g. शत्रुजित्, कोटिजित्.
जित a. (f. ता) 1. Conquered, subdued; 2. surpassed, excelled; 3. overcome by, enslaved by; 4. won, obtained, (pp. of जि q.v.).
जित a. (f. ता) 1. Conquered, subdued; 2. surpassed, excelled; 3. overcome by, enslaved by; 4. won, obtained, (pp. of जि q.v.).
जित-अक्षर a. reading well or readily.
जित-अमित्र a. triumphant over an enemy, victorious.
जित-अरि (I) a. 1. victorious over an enemy; 2. one who has subdued his enemies.
जित-अरि (II) m. an epithot of Buddha.
जित-आत्मन् a. self-subdued, void of passion.
जित-आहव a. victorious.
जित-इंद्रिय a. one who has subdued his senses, श्रुत्वा स्पृष्ट्वाथ दृष्ट्वा च भुक्त्वा घ्रात्वा च यो नरः । न हृष्यति ग्लायति वा स विज्ञेयो जितेंद्रियः M.ii.98.
जित-काशिन् a. appearing victorious, assuming the airs of victory, जितकाशी राजसेवकः Mud.ii.
जित-कोप, -क्रोध a. imperturbable.
जित-कोप, -क्रोध a. imperturbable.
जित-नेमि m. a staff made of the Aśvattha tree.
जित-स्वर्ग m. one who has won heaven.
जिति f. Victory.
जितुम m. The sign Gemini of the Zodiac (a word of Greek origin).
जितुम m. The sign Gemini of the Zodiac (a word of Greek origin).
जित्वर a. (f. री) Victorious, conquering, करदीकृतभूपालो भ्रातृभिरित्वरैर्दिशाम् Sis.ii.9.
